evidence.claim: Rule R1: Verify before you block on a weak signal: Rule R1: Verify before you block on a weak signal. If the case rests on a single signal (including a risk score alone) and your assessed fraud probability is below 0.70, recommend `VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER` or `STEP_UP_AUTH` before any block. Blocking a legitimate customer on one signal is a policy breach.

case.summary: Real-time legacy risk scoring flagged online transaction 3660355 ($228.01) on card C09177-K1, which formed part of a two-transaction sequence totaling $489.62 from device D009729 marked new to the account. Although this online purchasing was an activity shift, the calibrated fraud model score was minimal at 0.011, and the activity aligned with the cardholder's baseline billing region 337 and primary email domain. Device D009729 showed no proxy use and no association with any known fraud ring or prior closed fraud case. With the cardholder confirming the transactions through validation, the alert was concluded to be legitimate cardholder activity and closed without fraud.
